summary.en: Filter text and ranges, calculate with dates and make readable labels for missing values.
summary.bn: টেক্সট ও সীমা দিয়ে তথ্য বাছো, তারিখের হিসাব করো এবং অজানা মানের পাঠযোগ্য নাম দাও।

notes: CHECK constraints are enforced from MySQL 8.0.16. The examples also run on MySQL 8.4.

sections.title: Ask richer questions without changing stored facts

examples.title: Match a prefix and a list
examples.explanationHtml: Ayesha matches the name prefix. Meher and Sadia match the town list; OR permits either route into the result.

examples.title: Include range boundaries
examples.explanationHtml: Marks 75, 78 and 80 are all included. BETWEEN keeps the lower and upper boundaries as well as values inside.

examples.title: Measure and combine text
examples.explanationHtml: UPPER changes only the displayed names. CHAR_LENGTH counts characters, and CONCAT combines text with an identifier.

examples.title: Calculate overdue days on a fixed date
examples.explanationHtml: Only loan 402 is overdue and unreturned on 1 March. The ten-day difference does not depend on when you read the lesson.

examples.title: Replace missing towns and classify marks
examples.explanationHtml: IFNULL and COALESCE supply labels for 106 and 108. CASE assigns Tanvir’s three marks to Pass, Excellent and Fail, in section order.

practice.title: Compare range boundaries
practice.statementHtml: Return student_id, section_id and marks for marks BETWEEN 39 AND 40 in key order. Then count marks BETWEEN 101 AND 110 as n.
hints: Both the fail mark 39 and the pass boundary 40 belong to the first range.

practice.title: Label missing contacts
practice.statementHtml: On library data return member_id and COALESCE(email, Not supplied) as contact in key order. Then count known emails beginning with z as n.
hints: The display label should not overwrite the stored missing value.

practice.title: Find overdue and due-today loans
practice.statementHtml: On library data use 2026-03-02 as the reporting date. Return loan_id and DATEDIFF(reporting date, due_on) as days_late for open loans with due_on <= reporting date, ordered by loan_id. Then count open loans overdue before 2026-01-01 as n.
hints: A due-today loan has a difference of zero; distinguish it from an overdue loan.

practice.title: Correct CASE ordering
practice.statementHtml: A CASE tests marks >= 40 first and marks >= 80 second. Why can no Excellent label appear?
hints: The first true branch wins, even if a later branch is more specific.
practice.answerHtml: Every mark at least 80 already satisfies the first test, so CASE chooses its Pass branch and stops. Test the higher threshold first. Then test the pass threshold, followed by an ELSE for failures. An unknown mark needs an explicit missing-value policy.

practice.title: Keep dates meaningful
practice.statementHtml: Explain why an overdue report needs both returned_on IS NULL and a due-date comparison.
hints: Treat open status and lateness as separate conditions.
practice.answerHtml: A returned book may have an old due date but is no longer outstanding. The NULL test keeps open loans; the date test identifies those past their deadline on the stated reporting day. Use a strict earlier-than test when books due today are not yet overdue.

quiz.prompt: Does marks BETWEEN 75 AND 80 include 75 and 80?
quiz.explanation: BETWEEN is inclusive, equivalent to the lower and upper comparisons joined by AND for known values.

options: Names beginning with A under the chosen collation
quiz.explanation: Percent matches zero or more characters after the A prefix.

quiz.prompt: What does underscore mean inside a LIKE pattern?
quiz.explanation: Underscore matches one character; percent can match many.

quiz.prompt: Why use CHAR_LENGTH rather than LENGTH to count Bangla characters?
options: LENGTH counts bytes while CHAR_LENGTH counts characters
quiz.explanation: utf8mb4 can encode one character using several bytes; character count still differs from grapheme count.
COALESCE takes the first non-NULL argument in its ordered list.

quiz.prompt: If two CASE conditions are true, which matching branch supplies the value?
quiz.explanation: Searched CASE checks conditions in order, so put more specific cases first.

quiz.prompt: Why use a fixed date in an overdue-loan exercise?
options: The answer stays tied to a stated reporting day
quiz.explanation: A clear as-of date makes the meaning and result reproducible.

quiz.prompt: What does IN (1,3) mean for a known department_id?
quiz.explanation: IN tests membership in the listed alternatives.

quiz.prompt: How many results lie in the inclusive range from 75 through 80?
quiz.code: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM results WHERE marks BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

quiz.prompt: What is the overdue-day difference for loan 402 on 1 March 2026?
quiz.code: SELECT DATEDIFF('2026-03-01', due_on) AS n FROM loans WHERE loan_id = 402 ORDER BY loan_id;
quiz.explanation: The due date is 19 February, ten days before 1 March.

quiz.prompt: Which numeric value does COALESCE choose before any later fallback?
quiz.code: SELECT COALESCE(NULL, 0, 7) AS n ORDER BY n;
quiz.explanation: Zero is known, so COALESCE returns it without examining a later replacement.

keyPoints.en: BETWEEN includes both ends of the stated range.
keyPoints.bn: বিটুইন সীমার শুরুর ও শেষের মান দুটোই ধরে।

keyPoints.en: LIKE uses percent for many characters and underscore for one.
keyPoints.bn: লাইকে পারসেন্ট একাধিক আর আন্ডারস্কোর একটি অক্ষর মেলায়।

keyPoints.en: IN tests membership in a list of alternatives.
keyPoints.bn: ইন দিয়ে বিকল্প মানের তালিকায় কোনো মান আছে কি না দেখা হয়।

keyPoints.en: COALESCE returns the first value that is not NULL.
keyPoints.bn: কোঅ্যালেস প্রথম নাল নয় এমন মানটি দেয়।

keyPoints.en: CASE chooses a result from the first true condition.
keyPoints.bn: কেস প্রথম সত্য শর্ত অনুযায়ী ফলাফল বেছে নেয়।

examQuestions.question: Explain LIKE, IN and BETWEEN with boundary or wildcard cautions.
examQuestions.answerHtml: LIKE uses percent for zero or more characters and underscore for exactly one. IN checks listed alternatives and requires care if NULL appears. BETWEEN includes both endpoints. A reversed range does not automatically swap its bounds. Collation affects text matching.

examQuestions.question: A library wants a report as of 2 March 2026. Explain the open-loan and late-day logic.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Keep loans whose returned_on is NULL. For strictly overdue books require due_on earlier than 2026-03-02. DATEDIFF(reporting_date, due_on) gives positive overdue days. A loan due that day has zero days late and should be included only if the report also asks for due-today books.

examQuestions.question: Compare IFNULL, COALESCE and CASE without overwriting stored unknown values.
examQuestions.answerHtml: IFNULL picks its second argument when the first is NULL. COALESCE accepts several alternatives and returns the first known value. CASE chooses results using conditions and can express richer labels. All can be used in SELECT for display while leaving the original nullable column unchanged.
